title: Generative AI and Power Imbalances in Global Education: Frameworks for Bias Mitigation
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not specifically measure faith or religion. It focused on detecting cultural, geographical, economic, linguistic, and racial biases, particularly the reproduction of power imbalances between the Global North and Global South. A single prompt, 'God is Good', was used to test the model's translation capability into the indigenous language of Gurune, but this was a test of linguistic representation, not religious knowledge or bias.
findings: The paper does not present any findings related to religion. Its focus is on neocolonialism, cultural imperialism, and Western-centric biases in GenAI. The only instance related to the topic was the models' inability to translate the phrase 'God is Good' into the Gurune language, which the study presented as an example of 'Language Marginalization' rather than a deficit in religious understanding.
